title: 5-year entry-level overlap map and exposure-cap blocking for the AI traders
headline: Entry-level overlap is small: median same coin/side/15m-bar share 0.072 over 253 pairs (max 0.424, N10_HA_PSAR/N23_HA_ST). The live 4h-window co-occurrence (87-98%) is mostly density: 4h-window share median 0.548 vs 0.431 with B shifted 7 days.

Only two same-bet clusters pass the rule (kappa_1h >= 0.5 average linkage AND every pair's every-signal daily R corr >= 0.5): ST = {N23_HA_ST, S2_ST_ROC, N02_ST_KST, N01_ST_EMA}; RF = {DOGE, F7_RF_TRIPLE}. The proposed pullback (F16/F9) and DeepSeek-trend (F4/F6/F7) clusters and N10-in-ST are not supported.
One-position traders are weakly correlated: trader daily net R corr median 0.09, max 0.35; every-signal daily R corr median 0.28, max 0.82.

Proposed caps 3/1/8 on the 17 staffed traders (rule proxy): 0.354 of intended entries blocked, trades -0.128; DOGE -0.293, N02 -0.284. The book-direction cap 8 does most of it: uncapped median same-direction count is already 8.
Caps cut tail exposure but not edge: blocked entries' gross R +0.0135 vs taken +0.0041; book gross R change -718R [-1331, -118] over 5 years.

Uncapped 17: peak same-direction 17R (20.5R with 1.5% at 1h), p99 14R; 5+ free traders entering the same coin-side in the same 15m bar 38/yr, same hour 246/yr; 5+ holding the same coin-side 0.211 of the time.

Recommendation: swap S2_ST_ROC -> N09_ALLIG_AROON and N02_ST_KST -> F9_IFVG; keep DOGE+F7 under the RF cluster cap; paper-phase caps coin-side 4 / cluster 1 / same-direction 10 (0.102 blocked, trades -0.032 on the swapped 17); 3/1/8 scaled to the live count for real money.
Side finding: the -12R book daily stop fires on 0.469 of days for 17 rule-proxy traders (book mean -10.7R/day); recalibrate near -30R.

method.signals: lens2/multi_tf/outc every-signal ALONE outcomes (house exit, 15m-bar stop checks), 2021-08-01..2026-09-30, 6 coins; extracted by ovl5/build_sig.py (2,202,218 rows)
method.scope_note: 4h only for N23_HA_ST and F6_VWAP_CROSS and only signals sizable at 30x/20x; U scope = 15m/30m/1h + sizable 4h for all
method.share: A->B = share of A's (coin, side, entry bar) with a same coin-side B entry within the window; windows: same bar, +-1 bar of that tf, +-4h; card scope: same 15m moment, +-1h, +-4h
method.chance: B shifted by +-7 days (672 15m bars), averaged
method.kappa: (obs - chance)/(1 - chance), max over the two directions
method.daily_R_corr: Pearson corr of daily sums of every-signal net R (and gross R) on the card scope
method.trader: setup B one-position trader: longer tf, widest stop, coin order; no switching; occupies e..x; 1% risk
method.caps: checked at entry vs all open positions; blocked first choice -> next signal at same e, else stays flat; same-moment order: longer tf, widest stop, daily rotation of trader ids
method.uncertainty: week-block bootstrap (2,000) for book R changes; kappa IS/CF corr 0.996
verification: 1. uncapped joint == alone for all 17: True
4. brute-force setup B == run() for N10_HA_PSAR : True 13237
2/3. caps cs3/REC/book8: violations=0, own-overlap=0, intended=taken+blocked_flat: True
2/3. caps cs2/REC/book6: violations=0, own-overlap=0, intended=taken+blocked_flat: True
2/3. caps cs4/REC/book10: violations=0, own-overlap=0, intended=taken+blocked_flat: True

clusters.rule: average-linkage on kappa_1h (card scope, chance-corrected same coin-side entry within 1h, max over directions), cut 0.5; a cluster is kept only if every pair inside has every-signal daily net R corr >= 0.5

recommendations.caps_real_money: coin-side 3, cluster 1, same-direction about 0.5 x live traders (min 2)

swaps.why: S2 = closest duplicate of N23 (every-signal daily R corr 0.82, kappa 0.75)
N02 kappa 0.83 with N23; F9_IFVG most distinct of all 23

merge.note: keep both under one cluster cap; if one must go, F7 becomes a rule account

recommendations.book_daily_stop: -12R fires on about half of days for 17 rule-proxy traders; recalibrate near -30R (or traders x -1.75R)
recommendations.logging: every cap-blocked entry as REJECTED_CAP with its shadow outcome, included in the paired AI-minus-rule verdict

limits: rule proxies: an AI that skips more holds less and is blocked less (thin 0.5 sensitivity)
outcomes = every-signal alone house exits (ROE ladder at 30x/20x normal chain), not R exits under 1% risk sizing
15m/30m/1h infeasible signals included (code would pick lower leverage); 4h only where sizable
overlap is a property of the definitions (stable across halves) and says nothing about edge
same-moment order between traders emulated by a pre-registered rule; live order is AI response time
book R sums separate paper accounts
